description: List every token in a chain's issuer registry: symbol, name, contract address, ISIN, multiplier, whether it is minted on the chain and whether the issuer publishes a reference price. The answer opens with the exact count (also the `count` field); quote that number, do not estimate it from the list. On Base many listed tokens are not minted yet and do not trade (`minted`). Use it to enumerate or count the registry; to look up one token by name use find_stock_token, and to check one address use stock_passport. Two chains: base (Coinbase's tokens, symbols end in "c", e.g. NVDAc) and robinhood (Robinhood's, e.g. NVDA). When the user names no chain, call it for both. Facts with their time and source, not advice: https://proofofstock.com/docs/legal.md

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

name: list_stock_tokens
